messages.content: Hi, I'm Alex. I live in Rajshahi and work as a software engineer. I have a dog named Mochi.
Nice to meet you Alex! Rajshahi is beautiful. Mochi sounds like a cute dog.
I have a meeting tomorrow at 9am with the team.
Good luck with your meeting tomorrow!
Mochi passed away yesterday. I'm really sad about it.
I'm so sorry for your loss. Losing a pet is never easy.
I moved to Dhaka! Got promoted to senior engineer and adopted a cat named Pixel.
Congratulations on the promotion and the move! Pixel is a great name for a cat.
I got engaged to Sara! Also promoted to tech lead.
Double congratulations! Engaged to Sara and tech lead - that's amazing news!
